verdicts.reason: A pushes the whole T-and-text block into the top half, leaving roughly the bottom 45% as empty blue. Its red bar also stops short of the right edge, so it loses the original's bleed, and the stem stops floating mid-canvas instead of running to the bottom. B centres the block vertically and keeps the bar bleeding off the right edge as in the original, so it is more faithful and better balanced. But it is still the same small layout dropped into a tall canvas with large dead areas above and below. The stem is cut off mid-canvas, and the text is no bigger, so neither candidate actually rearranges the design for the story format.
